name: Little Spaces
summary:
Little Spaces is a puzzle-driven inventory management game about the harsh reality of being forced to move and leave behind your house.

The Player must organize their belongings into limited grid-based boxes. The core challenge comes from optimizing space efficiently while dealing with unpredictable interruptions. The game explores themes of control, personal space, and homelessness. Across two scenes, players both pack and reconstruct their stored items, reinforcing the sense of planning versus disruption.

The game was developed in TU Dublin in Collaboration with Focus Ireland.
